entities.name: Thom
entities.description: A Cabal cultist masquerading as a Tolarian student on Dominaria.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Cult to which Thom belongs, whose Stronghold is presided over by Belzenlok.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member Thom tried to kill, who then held him with a spell.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: Youthful, earnest Tolarian who used a magical interrogation technique on Thom.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: Enveloped in a black cloud by Thom's spell.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Target of an attack by Thom.

entities.name: Naban
entities.description: Left the room in cold fury during the interrogation.

entities.name: Cabal Stronghold
entities.description: The Cabal's base where Belzenlok presides.

events.summary: Thom poses as an innocent Tolarian student who stayed behind to help and admits finding a device at the crime scene.
events.quote: Thom deceived Jodah and the rest of the Weatherlight crew by pretending to be an innocent student

events.summary: Thom attacks Jodah with a dark globe of death magic, revealing his Cabal allegiance.
events.quote: he attacked Jodah with a dark globe of death magic, revealing his allegiance to the Cabal

events.summary: Thom envelops Liliana in a black cloud and attacks Gideon.
events.quote: Thom cast a spell that enveloped Liliana in a black cloud and attempted to attack Gideon

events.summary: Captured, Thom is held rigid by Jodah's spell and interrogated by Raff, which sends Naban from the room in fury; the Cabal Stronghold's location is learned.
events.quote: This enabled the team to discover the location of the Cabal Stronghold, where Belzenlok presided.
